metadata.description: ProAppStore Agent Skills and MCP server for building, securing, shipping, upgrading and auditing ProAppStore apps.

plugins.name: proappstore
plugins.description: Seven portable Agent Skills (create, architecture, auth and roles, data, publish and roll back, upgrade, audit) plus the ProAppStore MCP server (https://mcp.proappstore.online/mcp). Read-only by default; provisioning is dry-run then explicit confirm.
